Champagne
Champagne
DEUTZ
BRUT CLASSIC
Champagne Deutz, Brut Classic
This award winning champagne features
lovely aromas and flavours of pear and citrus
fruit. Layered with toasted hazelnut, honey
and sweet vanilla notes, the wine is balanced
by refreshing acidity with a long, lingering
finish. It is a perfect aperitif and goes well
with delicate dishes.
White Wines
FRAMINGHAM
MARLBOROUGH
Sauvignon Blano
Framingham Sauvignon Blanc 2002
Situated on the north bank of the Wairau
Valley, this pale straw green white wine
boasts pungent aromas of passionfruit and
grapefruit with tropical fruits and a hint of
crushed thyme on the palate. A well balanced
wine that goes well with seafood, white
meats as well as blue cheeses.
TACORY CREE
Chardonnay
Jacob's Creek Reserve Chardonnay 2001
This premium wine is an outstanding example
of South Australian Chardonnay. Attractive
peach and citrus aromas lead to rich, round
fruit flavours on the palate, while fermentation
on French oak has imparted sweet vanilla
characters and soft creamy yeast complexity.
A superb wine that is perfect with white
meats and seafood dishes.
Red Wines
Vacqueyras
Tean Paul et Cecile Selles
LES ARMES DE FRANCE
Vacqueyras Les Armes De Frances 1999
Vacqueyras, a wine area in the South Rhone
Valley of France, was elevated from a leading
Cote du Rhone village to join Chateauneuf-
du-pape and Gigondas as a region in its own
right in 1990.
This award winning wine is deep in colour
CX Signature Drinks
with a youthful purple rim. The aroma is lifted
by hints of blackcurrants from Grenache
grapes (50%) and crushed black pepper,
which is typical of cool grown Shiraz (50%).
The palate has soft grainy textured tannins,
which support supple, round fruit and spicy
flavours.
It goes well with most of the meat dishes
especially those cooked with Asian spices.
Pacific Sunrise
A refreshing combination of
champagne and Drambuie with
the zest of orange and lemon.
Cathay Delight
A kiwifruit based non-alcoholic
drink with coconut juice and a
touch of fresh mint.
Hope Estate Merlot 2000
A nice Merlot from the Hunter Valley, this
deep red wine is indicative of long warm days
that give it its complexity. This is a wine with
rich earthy depth of character with under lying
tobacco and cedar notes on the aroma while
the palate has plums and savoury herbs.
Great with red meats and hard cheeses.
Port
DOW'S
1996
Dow's Late Bottled Vintage Port 1995/
1996
Dow's is a family owned business that traces
its! history back to 1798. This Dow's Port
comes from the same vineyards that produce
Vintage Port, when a vintage is declared. It is
a full rich Port with spicy ripe fruit flavours,
well rounded on the palate and with an
elegant aromatic nose.
Cathay Pacific aims to offer a diverse selection of wines on
board - but apologies if on some flights a certain wine is
not available.
Our crew will always be happy to
recommend an alternative.
